candidates.description: 1 N-channel 115mA 2.5V 225mW 25pF 50pF 5pF 5Ω@10V 60V N-Channel ±20V SOT-23 MOSFETs ROHS
candidates.rationale: 2N7002 - JLC BASIC, 60V, SOT-23, $0.018, 458k stock. Two of these build a rail-independent hard disable: one as a discrete inverter on ENABLE, one clamping the pass FET gate to source. Works with the 3V3 rail absent, which matters because the ICD guarantees no mate sequencing (48V may arrive before 3V3). Pair with a passive gate pull-down so the stage is off with everything dead.

candidates.description: -40℃~+125℃ 1 1.2V、1.9V、2.4V、3.8V 1.65V~5.5V 10uA 2 24mA 24mA 300mV、400mV、450mV、550mV 74LVC 7ns@5V,50pF AND Gate SOT-353 Logic Gates ROHS
candidates.rationale: 74LVC1G08 AND gate (SOT-353, 1.65-5.5V, $0.056@6): the clean way to AND the PWM with ENABLE. Caveat: JLC has NO Basic single-gate logic at all, and an LVC input clamp will conduct from a live 3V3 PWM line into a dead Vcc - do not make it the only ENABLE interlock.
74LVC1G04 inverter, SOT-353, $0.057@6 - the logic-gate form of the NOT(ENABLE) needed to drive a gate clamp. Same power-off caveat as the AND gate.
